components.name: autocomplete
components.title: Autocomplete
components.description: Search first: a known list or a Livewire search, one or several values. Built on Flexilla Autocomplete.
message: Uses the listbox plugin: import { ListboxPlugin } from "./plugins/listbox"; Alpine.plugin(ListboxPlugin);
Server search: `search="query"` names the Livewire property that receives the typed text. Filter with bound parameters (whereLike), never by concatenating SQL.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut and radial charts rendered by Blade, with no chart library.
message: Register the chart script once in your Alpine setup: import { ChartPlugin } from "./plugins/chart"; Alpine.plugin(ChartPlugin);
Without Alpine, import { initChartInteractions } from "./plugins/chart" and call initChartInteractions() once.
Add `interactive` to the charts that should respond to the keyboard and legend clicks.

components.name: chart-helper
components.title: Chart helper
components.description: Server-side geometry for Flexiwind charts: scales, bars, paths, slices, rings and value formatting.

components.name: command-menu
components.title: Command menu
components.description: A ⌘K palette: grouped commands, nested pages, keyboard navigation and Livewire search, in a native dialog.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { CommandMenuPlugin } from "./plugins/command-menu"; Alpine.plugin(CommandMenuPlugin);
Open it with its shortcut (mod+k by default), <x-ui.command-menu.trigger />, or $commandMenu.open().

components.name: echarts
components.title: Advanced Charts (ECharts)
components.description: Zoomable time series, candlesticks, heatmaps, radar, scatter and funnels, drawn by Apache ECharts, loaded on demand and themed with your Flexiwind tokens.
message: ECharts has its own bundle: add 'resources/js/charts.js' to `input` in vite.config.js.
Load it only in the layouts that show charts: @vite(['resources/js/app.js', 'resources/js/flexilla.js', 'resources/js/charts.js']).
Do not register EChartsPlugin in flexilla.js and never import 'echarts' yourself: it would land in every page.
Add chart types to resources/js/plugins/echarts-core.js if you need more: each one stays its own file, loaded on demand.
Apache ECharts is Apache-2.0 licensed: free for every project, no license key.

components.name: file-trigger
components.title: File trigger & Dropzone
components.description: Open the file picker from any button, or drop files on a zone. Type and size checks before upload, Livewire progress.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { FilesPlugin } from "./plugins/files"; Alpine.plugin(FilesPlugin);
Browser checks only help: validate again in Livewire with `mimes` and `max`, and store files with store().

components.name: listbox
components.title: Listbox
components.description: A select you can style and compose part by part: one or several values, search, icons, avatars and groups. Built on Flexilla Select.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { ListboxPlugin } from "./plugins/listbox"; Alpine.plugin(ListboxPlugin);
wire:model receives a string, or an array with `multiple`. In a plain form, `name` posts one hidden field per value.
When options depend on another field, give the listbox a wire:key that changes with them.

Every part is a component: <x-ui.listbox.trigger>, .value, .content, .search, .list, .item, .label, .description, .icon, .avatar, .group, .empty… Bring your own <x-ui.listbox.content> and the composition is yours.

components.name: sparkline
components.title: Sparkline
components.description: A tiny trend line, area or bar series for KPI cards and tables.

components.name: tag-group
components.title: Tag group
components.description: Short labels to show, remove, or pick as filters: icons, dots, avatars and counts. Livewire-ready.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { TagsPlugin } from "./plugins/tags"; Alpine.plugin(TagsPlugin);
wire:model receives a string, or an array with `multiple` or `removable`.
Compose tags with <x-ui.tag>, <x-ui.tag.dot>, <x-ui.tag.count> and <x-ui.tag.avatar>, or pass :options.

components.name: tag-input
components.title: Tag input
components.description: A field that turns typed text into tags: topics, emails, keywords. Validation, limits, suggestions and Livewire search.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { TagsPlugin } from "./plugins/tags"; Alpine.plugin(TagsPlugin);
wire:model receives an array. Validate it again in Livewire: the browser checks only help people type.

components.name: rich-text
components.title: Rich text
components.description: A rich text editor with no dependency: marks, headings, lists, links, images and uploads. Every part is a component.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { RichTextPlugin } from "./plugins/rich-text"; Alpine.plugin(RichTextPlugin);
wire:model receives HTML. Clean it again on the server before you store or show it: App\Flexiwind\RichText::clean($this->body).
Image uploads go through Livewire: `upload` names a WithFileUploads property, `store` the method that validates it and returns the image URL.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Toast notifications from Livewire, a redirect or Alpine, themed with your tokens. Built on Flexilla Toast.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { ToastPlugin } from "./plugins/toast"; Alpine.plugin(ToastPlugin);
Put <x-ui.toaster /> once in your layout, before @livewireScripts.
From Livewire: $this->dispatch('toast', type: 'success', message: 'Saved'). After a redirect: ->with('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Saved']).

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed, with aria-pressed. Ghost, outline and primary variants.
message: wire:model receives a boolean. An icon-only toggle needs an aria-label.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle group
components.description: Pressed buttons that work together: toolbars, segmented controls, view switchers. One value or several.
message: Register the plugin in your Alpine setup: import { ToggleGroupPlugin } from "./plugins/toggle-group"; Alpine.plugin(ToggleGroupPlugin);
wire:model receives a string with type="single", an array with type="multiple".

components.name: sidebar-wrapper
components.title: Sidebar Wrapper
components.description: A full sidebar wrapper layout.
message: Wrap your sidebar markup with <x-ui.sidebar-wrapper> to get open/close toggle behaviour.
Import resources/js/sidebar-plugin.js in your Vite entry point (e.g. app.js) to activate the sidebar plugin.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to any button that should open/close the sidebar on mobile.

components.name: sidebar01
components.title: Sidebar 01
components.description: A full sidebar layout.
message: Include <x-layouts.sidebar> at the top level of your page — it renders as a fixed left panel.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> inside the sidebar nav for each link (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> after the sidebar; it offsets by md:pl-64 and holds your header + content.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.

components.name: sidebar02
components.title: Sidebar 02
components.description: A full sidebar layout with grouped navigation.
message: Include <x-layouts.sidebar> at the top level of your page — it renders as a fixed left panel.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-nav-group> inside the sidebar to group nav links under a labelled section.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> inside each nav group (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> after the sidebar; it offsets by lg:pl-64 and holds your header + content.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.

components.name: shell01
components.title: App Shell 01
components.description: Application shell layout.
message: Use <x-layouts.app-shell> as your root layout — it composes the sidebar and main content area.
The shell embeds <x-layouts.sidebar02> automatically; customise that file to change the sidebar.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> for each nav link inside the sidebar (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-nav-group> to group sidebar links under a labelled section heading.
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> inside the shell for the header + scrollable content region.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.
